title: Online Grocery Shopping:
Analysis and Design
background: Various diagrams were used to describe and design the online grocery shopping system as a whole. The diagrams used included use case diagrams, class diagrams, activity diagrams, sequence diagrams, as well as software architecture, data design, interface design, component design, and deployment design.
teamNote: This project was created by four people, including myself.
contributions: Analyze the needs and main components of an online grocery shopping system, such as users, products, orders, and payments.
Design use case diagrams, class diagrams, activity diagrams, and sequence diagrams using Rational Rose to visualize the flow and structure of the system.
Design the interface using Figma as a reference for the application display and basis for the system database design.
